lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows and five vertical columns within the visible lateral mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like arrangement, with high-intensity blobs functioning as nodal points at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running from the posterior gill region across the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots; at least seven commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral gills and pectoral fin.
